evidence_requirements.description: Exactly 500 registered elastic-structure model cells (125 structures by four models) with immutable receipts, no retries, no imputation, and a0/C11/C12/C44 observables.

At least 16 distinct non-tied applied structures per scorable class-property after structure-level aggregation across registered models; the locked panel must first prove at least 16 pre-outcome calibration-eligible structures per class-property.

Every correction decision emits exact fixed-point lo/hi/median audit values, the regime-optimal bias derivation, exact integer bstar candidate objectives and comparison cross-products, and THEORY-4 dynamic rounding-robust gate margins bound to the registered implementation digest; non-finite corrections abstain.

exclusions.rationale: Preregistered excluded_unavailable: no reproducible gated UMA checkpoint was available at lock time.
exclusions.subject: uma-family

exclusions.rationale: Round 5 measures elastic structures only; LiTraj/CI-NEB paths and barrier observables are a different campaign and cannot enter this panel.
exclusions.subject: litraj-neb-paths

exclusions.rationale: The legacy Round-4 jobs have drifted to mutable Z1 images and retries; Round 5 requires dedicated digest-pinned jobs with maxRetries zero.
exclusions.subject: legacy-round4-cloud-run-jobs

frozen_hypotheses.statement: Under the unchanged direction gate, the regime-optimal lo/integer-bstar estimator, and the rounding-robust machine-checked license, correction wins on at least three of four powered confirmatory properties in each registered material class.

At the distinct-structure sampling unit, the median paired hull-width difference across all four registered models is positive for C11/C12/C44 versus a0, tested as six Holm-controlled class-by-elastic-property secondary contrasts.
